title: Credit Risk Note: Long-Term Exposure Points on a Kestrel New Vehicle Retail Good-Faith Payment
content:
**Kestrel New Vehicle Retail Installment Sale Contract — contract length and the good-faith percentage.**

**Rule.** The contract length is the whole calendar months from the contract date to the contract's maturity date. When the contract length is at least 60 and the contract is on Kestrel New Vehicle Retail Tier 4 or Kestrel New Vehicle Retail Tier 5, 7 percentage points are added to the good-faith percentage; when the contract length is at least 60 on any other tier, 2.5 points are added; in every other case no points are added.

**Counting.** Whole calendar months from one date to a later one are the difference in month numbers, less one when the later date's day number is smaller than the earlier date's, with no month-end adjustment. The maturity date is the one the contract record shows today.

| Tier | Contract length 60 months or more | Fewer than 60 |
|---|---|---|
| Kestrel New Vehicle Retail Tier 5 | 7 points added | none |
| Kestrel New Vehicle Retail Tier 4 | 7 points added | none |
| Kestrel New Vehicle Retail Tier 3 | 2.5 points added | none |
| Kestrel New Vehicle Retail Tier 2 | 2.5 points added | none |
| Kestrel New Vehicle Retail Tier 1 | 2.5 points added | none |
| Kestrel New Vehicle Retail Tier 1+ | 2.5 points added | none |

## Boundary cases (hypothetical)

- Contract date the 5th of a month, maturity date the 5th of the month 60 months later: 60 whole months, so the points apply. Maturity on the 4th of that month: 59 whole months, none.
- A Tier 5 contract 61 months long: 7 points added; a Tier 1+ contract 72 months long: 2.5 points added.
